During the [[Battle of Mindor]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], an aged, modified '''''Bulwark''-class battleship''' served with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rapid Response Task Force]]. This [[Bulwark Mark I]] dated from before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was manufactured originally by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]].
